known.via: English Wikipedia "Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG" (redirects to "Cerasuolo di Vittoria")

blurb.text: Sicily's only DOCG, a dry red from around Vittoria, meaning cherry red. It blends Nero d'Avola, locally called Calabrese, at 50 to 70 percent with Frappato, with set cropping rates and a minimum alcohol of 13 percent.
